completion.releaseNote: `sati help <command>`, help for a group typed alone, clearer missing-argument errors, and `sati task claim --pick`.
completion.summary: Leftovers from 9j: fish completion run in fish 4.9.3 and fixed (no file names where a command goes, group flags), pager spawn moved to pipeTo and tested, hook runner and every hint name `sati upgrade`, `task claim --pick`, no check mark on a comment list that opens with a name. Review of the command line: a group typed alone prints its help, `sati help <command>`, missing arguments show what to type, `sati --bogus` is an unknown option, command lists show the first sentence, `sati completion` follows $SHELL. Tests pass with a 60 s timeout; the 5 s default timed out under machine load from other projects.

title: CLI DX pass: leftovers from 9j (fish check, pager test, hook text, task picker, stray tick) and a review of every command's help, errors and hints
